notes.title: Shooter's Island Patch 0.1.0.1
notes.notes:
[b]Shooter's Island Patch 0.1.0.1 is live![/b]

0.1.0.1 Patch Notes: 

[list]
[*]Fixed Forest flick training bug 
[*]Updated year on intro video
[*]Fixed player stepping up onto range button platform
[*]Reduced overall game file size
[/list]

Let us know what bugs you encounter in our discord so we can patch them out. We have a list of known bugs there. [url=https://www.discord.gg/hXPrH3w4nj]Join our Discord here.[/url]
